input: Book a flight for the family reunion in August

gold.taskTitle: Book a Flight for the August Family Reunion
gold.taskDescription: Research and book flights for the user and their family to attend a family reunion in August.

questions.title: What city or airport are you departing from?
questions.description: Identify the departure location for the flight.

questions.title: What city or airport is the reunion destination?
questions.description: Identify the arrival location for the flight.

questions.title: What are the exact travel dates in August?
questions.description: Determine the specific outbound and return dates needed for booking.

questions.title: How many passengers need tickets on this booking?
questions.description: Clarify the total number of travelers, including adults and children.

questions.title: Do any travelers require a specific seat class?
questions.description: Determine whether economy, business, or first class is preferred or required.

questions.title: Is there a total budget limit for all the tickets?
questions.description: Establish a spending ceiling to filter flight options appropriately.

questions.title: Which airline or booking platform do you prefer to use?
questions.description: Find out if the user has loyalty memberships, airline preferences, or a preferred booking site.
